notes.title: Thank you for your support in 2023. I appreciate it
notes.notes:
Hello, Master!

Thank you so much for playing our game in 2023.
Your support made this year truly special for us.
Thank you for all the feedback, support, and for sharing enjoyable moments with us!!

Looking back, it was a year of first-time challenges.
There were many difficult moments, but
I am honored to have been a bridge for you to meet our characters.

What will happen in 2024? We don't know yet.
Maybe I'll be creating my own new work, or supporting someone else's.
Maybe I'll be taking on EXECUTEDADDY 2.
However, the main updates for now have been perfected in 2023.
Two more 'Stealthy Steps' added! Have you seen them yet?

Nothing makes me happier than knowing that something I created has reached someone's heart and become a part of their life story.

I hope you all have a wonderful year!

Sincerely,

notes.title: Master walking at high speed is safe!
notes.notes:
Master! Hello!
Thank you for everything.

Master, have you ever been running and fell down and went blind?
Yes, that's an anomaly in the tower.

Now, the tower can withstand your high-speed movement!
Good for you, Master!

It is safe even if the master clicks at high speed.
We will continue to carry out the operation of the tower with the master's safety in mind.

Good bye!
It is getting colder, please be careful.

■This repair
No additional stories or text.

Fast travel repair
Endless mode can be viewed from the home page.
The endless mode is now viewable from the home screen.
Promise of live performance also added.

Other minor fixes
